feeds.title: Parka Blog
feeds.description: Parka Blogs started as a personal blog but has since evolved to feature more art products and art books relating to animation, movies, and comics. Parka Blogs features thousands of reviews for art supplies, products, and books related to anime, comics, films, and illustration. Find articles on sketching tips and techniques, art product and artbook reviews, and watercolor and fountain pens for painting and drawings in the blog.

feeds.title: Halcyon Realms
feeds.description: Blog of visual effects artist with a passion for animation, film, photography and pretty art books. This blog is the top resource for anime and Japanese art book reviews.

feeds.title: Motto Distribution Book Blog
feeds.description: This blog is dedicated to different discussions about publishing art, graphic design, photography, typography and related matters.

feeds.title: Byopia Press
feeds.description: This blog is authored by Cathryn Miller. She makes artist's books and alter discarded books.

feeds.title: Kids Book Explorer
feeds.description: Here you'll find announcements, reviews and surveys in relation to children's book industry events: book launches, illustration exhibitions, authors talks, this blog's partnerships and collaborations, etc.

feeds.title: Singapore Art Book Fair
feeds.description: Singapore Art Book Fair (SGABF) is an independent annual multi-day festival specialising in contemporary art books & zines. This blog features art books, art catalogues, monographs, zines, and printed ephemera.

feeds.title: Drēma Drudge Blog
feeds.description: Welcome! I'm Drema Drudge. The written word and I have been friends forever, it seems. I've been writing in one capacity or another since I was nine, starting with terrible poems and graduating to melodramatic stories in junior high.

feeds.title: Anteism Publishing Blog
feeds.description: Anteism is a Canadian publisher working with galleries and artists to produce unique art books. Our blog showcases the books we produce and the artist books we love!

feeds.title: Artblog
feeds.description: The artblog is a 501(c)3 non-profit organization providing arts commentary, news, reviews, features, podcasts and videos by a team of writers and artists.

feeds.title: The Art of American Book Covers
feeds.description: Richard Minsky is known for his conceptual approach to the book as an art object. He combines a background in economics with an innovative use of traditional methods and new materials to create sculptural, often political, bookworks. Follow this blog as it showcases Minsky's unique works in private and institutional collections as well as his editioned multiples.

feeds.title: Griffith Moon
feeds.description: We work with artists and writers to create works of art in the form of paper, wood, linen, wire and thread. No other medium conveys the physicality, authority, sensuality of a beautiful book, the ideal exhibition space for art and ideas.

feeds.title: Fuck Yeah, Book Arts!
feeds.description: A blog for creative types interested in the Unconventional world of Book Arts! Posts here will feature artist's books, illustration, book binding, typography, sketch-booking, scrap-booking, print-making, paper making, altered books, how to guides, zines, paper engineering and more!

feeds.title: Center for Book Arts Blog
feeds.description: This blog is dedicated to exploring and cultivating contemporary aesthetic interpretations of the book as an art object, while preserving the traditional practices of the art of the book.

feeds.title: Wells Book Arts Center Blog
feeds.description: The Book Arts Center is dedicated to teaching all aspects of the book arts, including letterpress printing, hand bookbinding, calligraphy and digital design. This blog is a center for craft, exploration, and learning.
